system.description:
You create a billowing cloud of fog that you, your party members, and friendly NPCs can see through, but it obscures the area from Mobs, making it more difficult for them to attack you. Mobs attack with Disadvantage against targets in the fog. This fog fills a 25ft x 25ft area. Smart Mobs may attempt to move the combat out of the fog if able.

Note: this persistent area-effect zone has no structural template support in this system - track manually.

upgrades.description: The fog fills a 50ft x 50ft area, and its duration is 1 minute.
The fog fills a 100ft x 100ft area and lasts for 5 minutes.
The fog fills a 500ft x 500ft area and lasts for 15 minutes.

system.duration: Until the end of two full rounds of combat or 20 seconds
